import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static final int MAX_D = 64, MAX_LG = 65;

    static long n_val, d_val;
    static List<Long> digit_list = new ArrayList<>();

    static class MatrixNode {
        long[][] mat = new long[MAX_D][MAX_D];
        long[][] buf = new long[MAX_D][MAX_D];
        boolean[] flag = new boolean[MAX_D];
        boolean[] tmp = new boolean[MAX_D];

        void combine(MatrixNode other) {
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_D; i++) {
                Arrays.fill(buf[i], 0);
            }
            for (int i = 0; i <= d_val; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= d_val; ++j) {
                    for (int k = 0; k <= d_val; ++k) {
                        buf[i][j] = (buf[i][j] + mat[k][j] * other.mat[i][k]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < d_val; ++i) {
                if (flag[i] && !other.flag[i]) {
                    for (int j = 0; j <= d_val; ++j)
                        buf[i][j] = mat[i][j];
                }
                if (!flag[i] && other.flag[i]) {
                    for (int j = 0; j <= d_val; ++j)
                        buf[j][i] = other.mat[j][i];
                }
                flag[i] |= other.flag[i];
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_D; i++) {
                System.arraycopy(buf[i], 0, mat[i], 0, MAX_D);
            }
            System.arraycopy(other.flag, 0, flag, 0, MAX_D);
        }

        void zeroize() {
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_D; i++) {
                Arrays.fill(mat[i], 0);
                Arrays.fill(buf[i], 0);
            }
        }

        void rotate(int shift_amount) {
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_D; i++) {
                Arrays.fill(buf[i], 0);
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < d_val; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < d_val; ++j) {
                    buf[(i + shift_amount) % d_val][(j + shift_amount) % d_val] = mat[i][j];
                }
                buf[(i + shift_amount) % d_val][d_val] = mat[i][d_val];
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < d_val; ++i) {
                buf[d_val][(i + shift_amount) % d_val] = mat[d_val][i];
            }
            buf[d_val][d_val] = mat[d_val][d_val];
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_D; i++) {
                System.arraycopy(buf[i], 0, mat[i], 0, MAX_D);
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < d_val; ++i) {
                tmp[i] = flag[(i + shift_amount) % d_val];
            }
            System.arraycopy(tmp, 0, flag, 0, d_val);
        }
    }

    static MatrixNode[] seg_tree = new MatrixNode[MAX_LG];
    static MatrixNode[] pref_tree = new MatrixNode[MAX_LG];
    static MatrixNode work_node = new MatrixNode();

    static MatrixNode compute_node(long x) {
        long block = x, block_size = 1;
        int depth = -1;
        while (block >= d_val) {
            block /= d_val;
            block_size *= d_val;
            ++depth;
        }
        x %= block_size;
        if (depth == -1) return pref_tree[(int)block];
        MatrixNode res = new MatrixNode();
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_D; i++) {
            System.arraycopy(seg_tree[depth].mat[i], 0, res.mat[i], 0, MAX_D);
        }
        System.arraycopy(seg_tree[depth].flag, 0, res.flag, 0, MAX_D);
        work_node = new MatrixNode();
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_D; i++) {
            System.arraycopy(seg_tree[depth].mat[i], 0, work_node.mat[i], 0, MAX_D);
        }
        System.arraycopy(seg_tree[depth].flag, 0, work_node.flag, 0, MAX_D);
        for (int step = 1; step < block; ++step) {
            work_node.rotate(1);
            res.combine(work_node);
        }
        work_node = compute_node(x);
        work_node.rotate((int)block);
        res.combine(work_node);
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n_val = sc.nextLong();
        d_val = sc.nextLong();
        --n_val;
        long orig = n_val;
        digit_list.clear();
        while (n_val > 0) {
            digit_list.add(n_val % d_val);
            n_val /= d_val;
        }

        pref_tree[0] = new MatrixNode();
        pref_tree[0].mat[(int)d_val][(int)d_val] = 2;
        pref_tree[0].mat[(int)d_val][0] = -1;
        pref_tree[0].mat[0][(int)d_val] = 1;
        pref_tree[0].flag[0] = true;
        seg_tree[0] = new MatrixNode();
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_D; i++) {
            System.arraycopy(pref_tree[0].mat[i], 0, seg_tree[0].mat[i], 0, MAX_D);
        }
        System.arraycopy(pref_tree[0].flag, 0, seg_tree[0].flag, 0, MAX_D);

        for (int idx = 1; idx < d_val; ++idx) {
            pref_tree[idx] = new MatrixNode();
            pref_tree[idx].mat[(int)d_val][(int)d_val] = 2;
            pref_tree[idx].mat[(int)d_val][idx] = -1;
            pref_tree[idx].mat[idx][(int)d_val] = 1;
            pref_tree[idx].flag[idx] = true;
            seg_tree[0].combine(pref_tree[idx]);
            pref_tree[idx] = new MatrixNode();
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_D; i++) {
                System.arraycopy(seg_tree[0].mat[i], 0, pref_tree[idx].mat[i], 0, MAX_D);
            }
            System.arraycopy(seg_tree[0].flag, 0, pref_tree[idx].flag, 0, MAX_D);
        }

        for (int lvl = 1; lvl <= digit_list.size(); ++lvl) {
            seg_tree[lvl] = new MatrixNode();
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_D; i++) {
                System.arraycopy(seg_tree[lvl - 1].mat[i], 0, seg_tree[lvl].mat[i], 0, MAX_D);
            }
            System.arraycopy(seg_tree[lvl - 1].flag, 0, seg_tree[lvl].flag, 0, MAX_D);
            work_node = new MatrixNode();
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_D; i++) {
                System.arraycopy(seg_tree[lvl - 1].mat[i], 0, work_node.mat[i], 0, MAX_D);
            }
            System.arraycopy(seg_tree[lvl - 1].flag, 0, work_node.flag, 0, MAX_D);
            for (int j = 1; j < d_val; ++j) {
                work_node.rotate(1);
                seg_tree[lvl].combine(work_node);
            }
        }

        MatrixNode final_result = compute_node(orig);
        System.out.println(final_result.mat[(int)d_val][(int)d_val]);
    }
}
